description.default: Export SiYuan documents as Markdown for hexo/Hugo: formulas become data-latex containers, tables keep merged cells as HTML, callouts, assets and heading levels are converted for a KaTeX-based static theme.
description.zh_CN: 把思源文档导出成可直接构建的 Hexo/Hugo Markdown：公式转 data-latex 容器、表格保留合并单元格、标注块转 callout、附件 ASCII 化并重写路径、标题降一级。
